actions.eval: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); return d ? [...d.querySelectorAll('section')].map(s => s.innerText.split('\n')[0].trim()) : 'no dialog' })()

(() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('section')].find(x => x.innerText.startsWith('Model')); if (!s) return 'no Model section'; s.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return s.innerText.slice(0, 900) })()

(() => { const ta = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find(t => (t.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('World services') || (t.labels?.[0]?.innerText ?? '').includes('World services')); if (!ta) return 'no field'; ta.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); ta.focus(); return ta === document.activeElement })()

(() => { const field = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find(t => t.value.includes('ws://127.0.0.1:8797')); let box = field; while (box && ![...box.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test')) box = box.parentElement; if (!box) return 'no Test'; const btn = [...box.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test'); btn.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); btn.click(); return 'clicked Test' })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('ws://127.0.0.1:8797\n'); return at < 0 ? 'no probe line' : t.slice(at, at + 400) })()
